exposure: Inhibitors of potential NiR enzymes (xanthine oxidoreductase, mitochondrial aldehyde dehydrogenase, mitochondrial bc1 complex)
outcome: Vasorelaxation in isolated pre-constricted chorionic plate arteries (CPAs) and veins (CPVs)
cohort: Placentas were collected from uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Nitrite caused concentration-dependent vasorelaxation in human chorionic plate arteries and veins, with this effect enhanced by hypoxia and dependent on the NO-sGC-cGMP pathway.
